glosses: mule (hybrid offspring of a male donkey and a female horse)

examples.text: O Tom não sabe a diferença entre uma mula e um burro.
examples.en: Tom doesn't know the difference between a mule and a donkey.

examples.text: O velho carregou a sua mula com sacos cheios de areia.
examples.en: The old man loaded his mule with bags full of sand.
